author: epicman05
body:
So I didnt know where to post this but two years ago I was banned for using Nodus

I abused it as you can seen in my recently killed on my profile and after two years, I've definitely learnt my lesson, I've moved to computer to laptop and no longer own any hacked clients and If unbanned I shall be mature and play legit among others, I really hope i'm unbanned this was my all time favorite server after a boring day of school!

After all, two years is a  long time :(


Many thanks,

Epic
